content_sections.heading: NIT Calicut Counselling Psychologist at a Glance
Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The institute has advertised a total of 2 vacancies for the post of Counselling Psychologist on a contractual basis under Post Code 01.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following educational qualifications, experience, and age criteria to be eligible for the NIT Calicut Counselling Psychologist position. Master’s degree in Psychology – M.A / M.Sc. in Psychology, Clinical Psychology, Counselling Psychology, or Applied Psychology; OR Master of Social Work (MSW) with specialisation in Psychiatry / Mental Health. RCI recognised professional qualification and valid RCI/CRR registration, such as: Master of Philosophy (M.Phil.) in Clinical Psychology Professional Diploma in Clinical Psychology (P.D. Cl. Psy.) Post Graduate Diploma in Rehabilitation Psychology (P.G.D.R.P.) Two years of experience in counselling is required. Candidates should preferably be below 50 years of age.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay ranging from ₹40,000/- to ₹60,000/- per month, commensurate with their experience and qualification. The appointment is on a full-time contractual basis for an initial period of one year, which is extendable based on performance and institute requirements.

content_sections.heading: NIT Calicut Counselling Psychologist Job Description
content_sections.text: The engaged Counselling Psychologists will perform the following roles and responsibilities: Counselling students. Coordinate with online wellness partner. Coordinate wellness events on campus and work with Students Guidance Cell volunteers. Submit a weekly report to the Dean (Students Welfare) Office on student caseload and well-being. Maintain professional boundaries with students and uphold confidentiality in consultations and diagnoses. Ensure information gathered during consultations is not disclosed, made public, or utilized in any way except for offering assistance to students. Conduct scheduled rotational visits across various departments, hostels, and academic facilities on campus to deliver specialized sessions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Calicut Counselling Psychologist
content_sections.text: Visit the online application portal via the official link (https://recruit.nitc.ac.in). Complete the online application form and pay the requisite application fee through the payment option provided in the portal. Print out a copy of the fully completed application form after submission. Mail a copy of the submitted application form along with all required supporting documents to [email protected] within five days from the closing date of application.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Applicants must email and produce the following documents during the recruitment process: Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) Diploma or Degree certificates with mark sheets of all qualifying examinations Experience certificates and testimonials Proof of date of birth ID proof Community or category certificate issued by the Competent Authority (if belonging to SC, ST, OBC-NCL, or PwBD claiming concessions)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be evaluated based on their qualifications and experience. The selection committee may conduct a skill test and/or trade test. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email or mobile, and selected individuals are expected to join immediately.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Calicut Counselling Psychologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The closing date for submitting the online application is 29 October 2026 at 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the post of Counselling Psychologist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master’s degree in Psychology (M.A / M.Sc. in Psychology, Clinical Psychology, Counselling Psychology, or Applied Psychology) or an MSW with specialisation in Psychiatry / Mental Health.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants must have at least two years of experience in counselling.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NIT Calicut Counselling Psychologist?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably below 50 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for general and reserved candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹500 for other candidates and ₹250 for SC, ST, Women, ESM, and PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay ranges from ₹40,000 to ₹60,000 per month, commensurate with experience and qualification.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this appointment is purely on a contractual and temporary basis for an initial duration of one year, extendable based on performance and requirement.

faq.question: Q9. Where should candidates send the printed copy of the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must mail a copy of the submitted application form along with required documents to [email protected] within five days from the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q10. What are the desirable or preferred qualifications?
faq.answer: Preferred qualifications include an RCI-recognised professional qualification and valid RCI/CRR registration, such as an M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology, Professional Diploma in Clinical Psychology, or Post Graduate Diploma in Rehabilitation Psychology.
